argv:
set -eu
aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc -std=gnu11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-parameter -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -DHEXAGONRPC_BUILD_METHOD_DEFINITIONS=1 -I/inputs/hexagonrpc/include -I/inputs/hexagonrpc/hexagonrpcd /fixtures/rpc_return_harness.c /inputs/hexagonrpc/hexagonrpcd/iobuffer.c -Wl,--gc-sections -o /output/return-harness
for test_case in normal large transport-error frame-limit budget; do
 HEXAGONRPC_RETURN_TRACE=1 qemu-aarch64 -L /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu /output/return-harness "$test_case" > "/output/return-$test_case.stdout" 2> "/output/return-$test_case.stderr"
done
qemu-aarch64 -L /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu /output/return-harness normal > /output/return-disabled.stdout 2> /output/return-disabled.stderr
chown -R "$HOST_UID:$HOST_GID" /output/return-*
